arjun.look: handsome Indian prince, medium-brown skin, large expressive dark eyes, curly shoulder-length black hair half tied up, small gold crown (mukut) with one peacock feather, golden-yellow dhoti with a maroon sash, gold armlets and a pearl necklace, carries the golden bow Gandiva decorated with peacock-feather patterns. As a child (age 8): same face, round cheeks, hair in a small topknot, simple yellow dhoti, a tiny wooden bow

dronacharya.look: dignified elderly teacher, white beard and moustache, topknot, saffron robe with a white shawl, rudraksha beads, kind but stern eyes, holds a long bow

krishna.look: blue-skinned Lord Krishna, gentle smile, large lotus-shaped eyes, golden crown with a peacock feather, yellow pitambar dhoti, garland of flowers, gold ornaments. As charioteer he holds the reins of four white horses and sits calmly in front of the chariot

kunti.look: gentle royal mother, warm kind eyes, white and soft-pink saree with a gold border, a light veil over her head, simple gold jewellery

draupadi.look: graceful princess in a red and gold bridal saree, long black hair with flowers, a garland of flowers in her hands, dignified calm smile
